description: Plural-folding parity fixture shared by route-core.js normalizeWord()/wordsOf() and build_local_skill_map.py _normalize_word()/_words_of(). Values are the recorded output of the functions; tests/skill-map/test_router_matching.js (node) and tests/rhize-context-manager/test_build_local_skill_map_inferred.py (pytest) assert both languages reproduce every entry. Rule: -ies -> -y when len > 4; else drop a trailing -s that is not -ss when len > 3; nothing else (no -ing).

knownCollisions.note: Cross-surface collisions: folding is identical in JS and Python, so these fold the same way on both sides, but distinct words can meet (news/new, https/http). Parity proves identical behavior across languages, not harmlessness; evaluate routing impact with evals/skill-map-routing when a collision involves a signal label.

knownNonFolds.note: -es plurals of -ss/-sh/-x words keep the e, so the singular and plural stay distinct (same as before folding existed).
